# ghost/giggity

Read public conference dates, programs and session metadata in Giggity without reminders or private calendars

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/giggity
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/giggity open --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/giggity read_catalog --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/giggity open_conference --device <serial> --param name=<name>
ghost skill run ghost/giggity read_program --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/giggity open_session --device <serial> --param title=<title>
ghost skill run ghost/giggity read_session --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/giggity close_session --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `open`: Open Giggitys public preconfigured conference catalog with notifications denied
- `read_catalog`: Read the first three complete public conference names/date ranges; no parameters
- `open_conference`: Load a currently exposed public preconfigured conference program
- `read_program`: Read the displayed program date/header and exposed native session labels
- `open_session`: Open a unique currently exposed public session without touching reminder controls
- `read_session`: Read public session title/room/displayed time and native description preview
- `close_session`: Close a proven read-only session detail and return to its program
